about.heading: Serving Customers and Helping Others Build a Life in the Trades
paragraphs: Our founder, [Founder Name], started out in the trades right after school. The road wasn't smooth, and there were plenty of people who doubted the path, but a few years later a contractor's license and a first small business were in hand.
When tough times hit, the business had to start over. With a small trusted team and a lot of determination, [Founder Name] rebuilt it from the ground up into the home service company it is today.
